name: chapter-card
label: A chapter opens: its number and its title, big, for 2 to 3 seconds

variant.label: number = a huge numeral beside the title, stack = eyebrow over a big title with the key word marked, panel = a card that slides in from the side

number.label: The chapter number (or a short mark like 2/5)

eyebrow.label: The small word before the number

title.label: The chapter title, at most 6 words

hot.label: stack: the word to mark (blank = none)

out.label: edge = leave by its edge at out_at, cut = hold to the end

out_at.label: edge: when it leaves (blank = 0.4 s before the end)
